pipeline.section_subtitle: Key active projects and experimental software currently under development.

projects.name: Easy Forms
projects.problem: A Next.js 16 form builder with a multi-persona AI agent that lets users build, edit, and analyze forms through natural language — with sandbox isolation, human-in-the-loop merge approval, and strict security invariants.
highlights: Multi-persona AI agent (Drafter → Planner → Executor → Evaluator → Communicator)
Sandbox-first mutations with MongoDB transactions + idempotency keys
Canary deployment, runbook, and secret scanning
Sandboxed agent tool execution with PII redaction before LLM calls

projects.name: PVVault
projects.problem: A private, on-device media vault where nothing leaves the phone. SQLCipher-encrypted storage, on-device AI grouping with TFLite embeddings, visual similarity clustering, and story-based video export.
highlights: SQLCipher-encrypted local media vault (no cloud, no MediaStore)
On-device TFLite embeddings for visual similarity & duplicate detection
Story algorithm: reference frames + similarity ordering → MP4 export
Custom video player (seek, brightness/volume drag, speed, rotate, zoom)
EXIF/camera metadata extraction and sidecar file support

projects.name: Image Story Video
projects.problem: An automated visual-story editor that takes unordered photographs, analyzes, groups, sequences, and renders them into coherent slideshow-style videos with intelligent transitions — all local-first via FastAPI.
highlights: Pipeline: scan → analyze → similarity → cluster → sequence → timeline → render

projects.name: Quiz Generator
projects.problem: Generates personalized quizzes for students and teachers from raw notes and books in seconds. Tailored to student learning styles, 100% free, and completely local-first.
highlights: Fast & accurate quiz generation from text/documents
Personalized quiz difficulty & learning style tuning
